title: [UPGRADE] 2 Pack Square Super Wide Mouth Airtight Glass Storage Jars with Lids, 1.1 Gallon Glass Jars with 2 Measurement Marks, Canning Jars with Leak-proof Lid for Kitchen(Extra Label and Gasket)
description:
About this item
Super Wide Mouth: Mouth size: 4.3in/10.9cm, this glass mason jar with a wide opening, It’s wide enough to put a 1 measuring cup in it, also It's easy to reach in and take food or scrub the bottom
With Tick Marks: The Cookie jars with fluid ounce (american unit of capacity) and millimeter(international volume unit), no need to use a measuring cup, more convenient to measure
Airtight Leak-proof Lid: The hinged lid and the silicone gasket are tightly matched to provide a double seal, great for both dry food and drinks, keep food fresh and drinks does not overflow.
Thickened Glass: Each airtight jar (excluding the lid) weighs 3.24 lbs, which is 0.4-0.7 lbs heavier than a normal glass jar, The thickening of the glass walls makes the bottle more durable and stable
Saving space: The capacity of square glass jars is 4200ml, which size is 10 inches*5.1 inches, small size but large capacity, very suitable for shelf, cabinet, pantry, countertop
Extra Gaskets: Each package come with 2 extra silicone gaskets, 2 stickers and 1 marker pen.
Anti-Crack Tips: Soak the jars with airtight lids with warm water before adding boiled water. Avoid SUDDEN temperature changes, such as adding boiled water without a warm-up process or putting a hot jar on a cool or wet surface

I need to keep my pantry well stocked as it is quite a trek to get to the nearest grocery store. I need to keep things in stock and keep them fresh. These are great!I should’ve purchased these long time ago. reviews_1s:
There is nothing wrong with the product as advertised or delivered. They are air tight with the silicone and rubber gaskets. They clean well in the dishwasher and are the size indicated in the description and are glass and I wish more glass storagr containers came in square shapes because that makes absolute sense for storage.

But... after having them for a year, I finally acknowledged to myself that I hate them. I've pinched myself a number of times dealing with the latch. When I pull them apart to run the glass through the dishwasher, I can never remember which way to reinstall the metal ring and thr gaskets and I get it upside down sometimes which is not a huge deal because seriously it's like 2 seconds to flip it. These are also so large that when full, they're heavy.... so they're not great for taking in and out of the pantry. They're great if you can just leave them out or have a walk in pantry with counter top type of setup.

I'll be swapping these out with something else soon. Again... they work, so if they match your product requirements, don't let my review dissuade you.Spent two days cooking my annual beef stew for freezer storage. Filled the jars and left 3/4 inch head room. Pre-chilled the jars and product to 33 degrees(F)before placing in deep freezers(-10). All eight jars cracked! Took me half a day to carefully remove the broken pieces and to shave down the product(to remove all traces of glass) and defrost the stew to be placed into other jars. These jars should not be used for freezers.The metal around the neck started flaking off pieces of glass. I got a painful piece in my foot and then realized where it was coming from when I saw a few more around the base of the jar. I moved the metal ring a little and more came off. Threw them in the trash.One of the jars in the package arrived with a hairline crack across the bottom of it on both jarsCheap Chinese crap where the metal lid holders don't work as they were put on wrong. I returned to Amazon.I bought this like April 13, broken on May 14.... 31 days of normal use is not a value for $16.50 a crack I can use paper cups or just not bother to store anything. TOOK ALL THE SAVINGS OUT. THEY KNEW IT WAS NO GOOD, NOTE "IMPROVED THICKNESS FOR DURABILITY", So they have had problems, and still do. Dont buy this product. Very disappointed. I'm 71 tears old, not wild or abusive. I slid one over to the other, it broke. Waste. They probably don't monitor this thread or back up their product, so I'm screwed. Dont you be too.
Update: They contactedme and offered me a refund, which was very nice of them. The containers are fine, but the glass us a little concave, and very thin beginning about an inch or two from the bottom. It focuses energy from bumps towards the center, the thinnest glass, so be careful using them. The seals, by the way are great. Updating to 3 stars from 1, because they backed up the product.Decent jars until they break. I used them for storing sugar and flour. The sugar jar broke a few months after normal use.
